name: crystalline-reality-merlin-bonus-prepare-choose-two
notes: Crystalline Reality (iPpwkMxDt5, GeneratedMacroCode.php cardActivatedAbilities["iPpwkMxDt5:0"] / GameLogic.php CrystallineRealityStart/QueueModes/ResolveModes/ApplyCrystallineRealityMode): "[Merlin Bonus] Prepare 1. Choose one. If CARDNAME was prepared, choose two instead -- Summon a Memorite Blade token. / Your champion gains true sight until end of turn. / Draw a card into your memory." The champion is patched directly to Merlin, Memorite Vassal (Merlin Bonus) with a preparation counter already on them. Playing the card (2 reserve, paid into memory) offers 'Pay Prepare 1?' -- answering YES spends the counter and raises the MZMODAL choice count from 1 to 2; picking modes A (summon) and C (draw into memory) both resolve. Verified live: a Memorite Blade token lands on the field, memory count goes from 2 (the 2 reserve cards) to 3 (plus the drawn card), and the preparation counter is spent. Break/restore verified: commenting out the SummonMemorite() call in ApplyCrystallineRealityMode's case 0 makes the token-existence assertion fail; restoring it passes again.
